item.impaled.pitchfork.tooltip: Early game trident with lower durability. Allows farmland tilling.
item.impaled.hellfork.tooltip: Nether trident. Fireproof, ignites entities, riptide works with fire/lava.
item.impaled.soulfork.tooltip: Soul variant. Uses experience for riptide, sets user on fire briefly.
item.impaled.elder_trident.tooltip: Homing trident that catches loot. Riptide spawns guardian copies.
item.impaled.atlan.tooltip: Legendary golden trident. Accepts both trident and sword enchantments.
item.impaled.maelstrom.tooltip: Throws tridents from inventory. Accepts Efficiency, Unbreaking, Mending.
